name: otto-monorepo
description: Otto — the AI that earns its keep. Monorepo: web (backend + dashboard) + mobile (Expo).

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C web install && pnpm -C mobile install
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C mobile exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.free: lsof -ti:8787 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo port 8787 freed
